calls.reasoning: Reference class: elite European internationals where the away side is somewhat stronger, about 30/27/43. FanDuel 1X2 (Italy +310 / Draw +300 / France -140) de-vigs to about 23/23/54; Polymarket's draw-only contract at 0.27 (matching terms) supports a draw in the mid-20s. France lead the group, are unbeaten in five with 2 conceded, and won 3-1 at San Siro in Nov 2024 (the away side won both 2024/25 meetings, correcting the background). Small allowance for Italy at home needing the win and the 1-1 in Paris; France's fitness doubts (Mbappe/Saliba/Konate) are unresolved.
calls.reconciliation: Disputed facts: (1) the 2024/25 head-to-head. Run 2 says the away side won both (France 1-3 Italy in Paris, Sep 2024; Italy 1-3 France in Milan, Nov 2024); the background and Run 3 say the home side won both. My own knowledge backs Run 2, and so does Run 3's note that Italy have lost their last three at San Siro. This removes the 'Italy won 3-1 at San Siro' argument the runs used to lift Italy. (2) Draw price: only Run 2 reports +300; with the reported Italy +310 / France -140 that de-vigs to about 23/23/54. The Polymarket draw contract (matching terms, volume unknown) is at 0.27, so I put the draw between those, at 26. No web access on this run, so the draw price could not be checked further. Judgment: the runs' shading toward Italy was partly built on the wrong H2H fact, so I sit nearer the market, with France at 51, above all three runs and slightly below the de-vigged book.
